content:
[V] med | bottom edge | "Automatic draft replies" row is clipped at viewport bottom, indicating unscrolled content cut without scrollbar affordance visible.
[L] med | bottom, right | Toggle controls are pushed to the far right edge (~1350px) while their labels sit far left, creating an unstructured full-width row with a huge dead gap between label and control.
[S] med | Synchronization card, inputs column | Input field widths are inconsistent — number fields ~105px, Agent language field ~200px, dropdowns differ in width again — breaking column rhythm.
[S] low | Synchronization card | "Synchronization" heading has noticeably larger gap to first row than the inter-row spacing elsewhere; vertical rhythm uneven.
[H] med | Data retention card | Two dense paragraph blocks of compliance/what-gets-deleted text run at near-equal weight to the field label, competing with functional controls and reading like unstyled debug/help dumps.
[H] low | Data retention card | Help text "what gets deleted…" and "compliance trade-off…" are lowercase run-on sentences with no heading or grouping, visually indistinguishable from body data.
[C] high | Right half of Synchronization card | Entire right ~60% of the card is empty white space, with all controls huddled in the left third — unmanaged dead zone.
[C] med | Right half of Data retention card | Same left-heavy clustering; long text wraps to full width while the field sits isolated in the left column, leaving the card visually lopsided.
[S] low | Top of Data retention paragraph | Spacing between the retention field row and the "what gets deleted" paragraph is tighter than the card's internal heading spacing, cramped.
[H] low | Tabs row | Inactive tab labels (Help Scout, LM Studio, etc.) are close in weight to the active tab, weak active-state differentiation beyond the underline.
[L] low | Synchronization labels | Label column left-aligned at ~46px but retention/help paragraphs indent at ~46px too while toggle labels start further left (~46px) — minor left-edge misalignment between card sections.
[S] low | AI behaviour rows | Vertical gaps between "AI enabled", "Automatic analysis", and "Automatic internal notes" rows are slightly uneven compared to the Synchronization card's row spacing.

TOTAL 13
